root_cause.text: The function bq257xx_reg_dt_parse_gpio() acquires a device node reference via of_get_child_by_name() but leaks it if the subsequent call to of_get_child_by_name() for the subchild fails and returns early without calling of_node_put(child).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "if fails to get subchild, it returns without calling of_node_put(child), causing the device node reference leak." The patch moves of_node_put(child) before the NULL check for subchild to ensure the reference is always released.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message states: "if fails to get subchild, it returns without calling of_node_put(child), causing the device node reference leak." The patch moves of_node_put(child) before the NULL check for subchild to ensure the reference is always released.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix reference leak by calling of_node_put(child) before returning on NULL subchild.
intent_record.what: Moved of_node_put(child) from after the NULL check on subchild to before the check, so it is called unconditionally.
intent_record.how: Prevents a reference leak on the child device node when of_get_child_by_name returns NULL, by ensuring the reference is always decremented.

grouping_result.intent: Fix reference leak by calling of_node_put(child) before returning on NULL subchild.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent is to fix the reference leak by adding of_node_put(child) before returning on NULL subchild, which directly addresses the vulnerability root cause.

candidates.rationale: This early return exits the function without releasing the child device node reference acquired earlier via of_get_child_by_name(), causing a reference leak when subchild is NULL.

vuln_statements.explanation: This early return exits without calling of_node_put(child), leaking the device node reference acquired via of_get_child_by_name() earlier in the function.

Author: Chris Morgan <macromorgan@hotmail.com>

    regulator: bq257xx: Add bq257xx boost regulator driver
    
    Add support for the boost regulator found in the Texas Instruments
    BQ25703. The boost regulator is capable of outputting between 4.48
    and 20.8 volts and between 0 and 6.35 amps.
    
    Signed-off-by: Chris Morgan <macromorgan@hotmail.com>
    Reviewed-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>
bic_trace_step.reason: In function bq257xx_reg_dt_parse_gpio, child is obtained via of_get_child_by_name() and not released if the subsequent of_get_child_by_name() for subchild fails: lines 'child = of_get_child_by_name(...); if (!child) return; subchild = of_get_child_by_name(child, ...); if (!subchild) return;' The early return on !subchild does not call of_node_put(child), causing a reference leak. No fix is present in this commit.
